company.title: Freedom Fusion AI LIVE Studio
company.text: Freedom Fusion AI LIVE Studio pairs a live human host with Professor Whiskers, an animated AI co-host covering CompTIA Network+, cybersecurity, and practical AI automation live on TikTok.

company.title: Public Wi-Fi Security
company.text: Public Wi-Fi is convenient, but open networks expose unencrypted traffic and risk evil-twin rogue access points. Always verify HTTPS, turn off auto-join, and route sensitive sessions through a trusted VPN.

company.title: How VPNs Protect You
company.text: A VPN creates an encrypted tunnel between your device and a VPN server using protocols like WireGuard or IPsec, hiding your traffic from local Wi-Fi eavesdroppers and masking your IP address from destination sites.

company.title: Cellular Handoffs in Dense Cities
company.text: As you walk through Manhattan, your phone continuously reports signal strength to nearby 5G and LTE base stations so the network executes fast handoffs between cell towers and small cells without dropping your LIVE stream.

company.title: OSI Model Quick Breakdown
company.text: The OSI model stacks seven layers from Physical hardware up to Application software—remembering Please Do Not Throw Sausage Pizza Away helps pinpoint whether an outage is cabling at Layer 1, switching at Layer 2, routing at Layer 3, or an app issue at Layer 7.

company.title: Zero Trust Architecture
company.text: Zero Trust assumes no user or device is trusted by default—even inside the network. Every request requires explicit identity verification, least-privilege access, and continuous monitoring.

memory.title: Manhattan Walk & Talk Format
memory.text: The host streams live while walking around Manhattan and joins Freedom Fusion LIVE as a guest while Professor Whiskers handles viewer questions, animations, and Network+ breakdowns.
